title: pruner
description: What the pruner writes as it ends, at .rn/<work>/pruner.json, for rn's hook to take into the steering once the pruner ends: the work's opportunity solution tree whole as it weighed it, and, where it settled them, the issues of the work and the steps to the target. No commit holds it.

message.description: What the weighing changed and why, in one sentence, for the commit's message.

steps.description: The way to the target, first to last, the walking skeleton first. A step or a deliverable that the steering already holds keeps its status.

next.description: Where the weighing decides what the deliverable takes next: generator, to make it again on what was weighed, within LIMIT judged Rounds; anew, to make it again from its first Round, as the solution it was made on changed; fixer, to mend it; refactorer, to refactor it; done, to end it. Absent, it goes on as the steering holds it.
